blocks.rationale: Create one joint package covering all three trigger failures: a scoped statutory-subclause classifier for §3306(b)(10)(A), and an itinerary-sensitive baggage calculator that distinguishes cabin items from checked bags, applies positional checked-bag fees, uses the higher of overweight and oversize charges, and optimally assigns complimentary higher-weight allowances. The latter yields 1433 for Karen and 3695 for Emily without encoding either answer.
